#declare use_focal_blur = 0; // 0=off 1=low quality 10=high quality

// Include file generated by Bullet Physics Playground

box { <-0.375, -0.125, -2.375>, <0.375, 0.125, 2.375>
  texture {
    pigment { rgbt <1, 0, 0, 0> }
  }
  matrix <1,0,0,
          0,1,0,
          0,0,1,
          0,1,0>
}

camera {
  location < 0, 0, 0 >
  right image_width/image_height*x
  look_at <0, 0, 1e+06>   angle degrees(2*atan(tan(radians(45)/2)*image_width/image_height))
  sky <0, 1, 0>
#if(use_focal_blur)
  aperture 0
  blur_samples 10*use_focal_blur
  focal_point <0, 0, 0>   confidence 0.9+(use_focal_blur*0.0085)
  variance 1/(2000*use_focal_blur)
#end
}

    pigment { rgbt <0, 0, 1, 0> }

}
